gen-noto-serif-fs-public-sans: Literary Noto Serif holds modest weight shifts over Public Sans. Broad open counters on a hefty sans-serif lowercase against that readable heading modulation is the spark.
gen-noto-serif-fs-supreme: Modest weight shifts in rounded lowercase mark Noto Serif over Supreme on the heading. Supreme then holds a heavy mid-strip of letters, held open, under that literary heading.
gen-noto-serif-general-sans: Pressed-glass bowls mark Noto Serif over General Sans on the heading. General Sans then holds a tube-like stroke, a sans filling the line under that mild heading contrast.
gen-noto-serif-satoshi: Noto Serif holds modest weight shifts in rounded lowercase over Satoshi. Satoshi then holds a soaring x-height through a full column, every stroke cut to one measure.
gen-noto-serif-switzer: Noto Serif holds modest weight shifts over Switzer on the heading. Wooden-stamp contrast against Switzer's single flat line is what stands out in the sans-serif on the sheet.
gen-orbitron-fs-bespoke-serif: Letters spread far apart mark Orbitron over Bespoke Serif, a large eye on every e. Bespoke Serif likes a modest size so those half-weight thins stay easy through copy.
gen-orbitron-poppins: Poppins reads as modern plain sans, rope-loose curves under Orbitron on the heading. Orbitron does the far-apart shout best, while Poppins holds unknotted curves through copy.
gen-playfair-display-fs-merriweather-san: Literary Playfair Display swings from heavy shoulder to thin arc over Merriweather Sans. Merriweather Sans then holds sturdy lowercase under those open letter mouths on the sheet.
gen-playfair-display-fs-spline-sans: Dignified Playfair Display dwarfs hairlines with fat strokes over Spline Sans. Spline Sans likes a modest size so that unvarying line stays easy through running copy.
gen-playfair-display-fs-supreme: Literary Playfair Display sets stout stems against delicate lines over Supreme. That heading stays loud in a few large words, leaving Supreme to carry copy on the sheet.
gen-playfair-display-outfit: Dignified Playfair Display dwarfs hairlines with fat strokes over Outfit. That heading stays loud in a few large words, while Outfit holds cable-bent letters, a plain sans.
gen-playfair-display-switzer: Fat strokes beside hairlines mark Playfair Display over Switzer. And running copy in that plain sans stays easy, tubular wire letters with c tips held apart.
gen-playfair-display-work-sans: Bold stems on hairline feet mark Playfair Display over Work Sans. Playfair Display does that picket-fence shout best, while Work Sans holds paperclip strokes through copy.
gen-silkscreen-inter: Inter reads as a tube-like sans-serif, hollow-reed counters under Silkscreen. Inter holds those counters through copy, while Silkscreen does the spaced spaghetti shout best on the sheet.
gen-silkscreen-poppins: Spaced spaghetti lines mark Silkscreen over Poppins on the heading. Poppins then holds unknotted curves through a full column of sans under that lo-fi shout on the sheet.
